'''Carida Corsairs''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang active for over two hundred years before the [[Galactic War]]. Once a formidable threat to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the gang suffered a big loss when their [[Carida Corsairs' base|base]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] was destroyed by a Republic strike force. As a result, the Corsairs were soon torn apart, and the group's survivors became a laughing stock to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. By [[3637 BBY]] they maintained a notable presence in the [[Raider's Cove]] town on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carida Corsairs pirates first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
